appearances.snippet: Anyway, I received a tip from some UVU students. They told me that the admin lot, they all refer to it as the admin lot. ... We've since determined that technically it's the admissions lot. But they told me that it's regularly used by the feds. Now, I want you to remember that UVU campus has a high federal presence because it is a pipeline school to go work for the feds, to work for the CIA, to work for the NSA and or for the Department of Defense.
